data.description:
# CLI safety: export/import help text warnings

## Context
After a destructive `wl import` incident in the SorraAgents project (a work item was moved between projects via export/import and the source DB was replaced), the operator requested (2026-08-27, Tableau-Card-Engine session herdr-1787866878):

> make the --help text for import and export much clearer. Warn that export will export the entire database and import will replace the entire database

## Change
- `src/commands/export.ts`: description now warns the export writes the entire database (all items, comments, dependency edges) to the JSONL file.
- `src/commands/import.ts`: description now warns import is destructive — it REPLACEs the entire database with only the items in the JSONL file.

Both are description-only changes to the CLI help; no behavior change.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `wl export --help` output contains the warning that export writes the entire database.
2. `wl import --help` output contains the warning that import is destructive and REPLACEs the entire database.
3. Existing test suite passes (the changes are description-only; no CLI behavior changes).
data.title: Warn in wl export/import --help that export dumps the whole DB and import REPLACEs it

Intake auto-complete: work item is well-defined and implementation is already complete. All 3 acceptance criteria verified: (1) Usage: worklog export [options]

Export work items and comments to JSONL file. WARNING: This exports the entire database — all items, comments, and dependency edges. Use the --file option to specify the output path.

Options:
  -V, --version           output the version number
  --json                  Output in JSON format (machine-readable)
  --verbose               Show verbose output including debug messages
  -F, --format <format>   Human display format (choices: full|summary|concise|normal|raw|markdown|plain|text|auto)
  -w, --watch [seconds]   Rerun the command every N seconds (default: 5)
  --worklog-dir <path>    Explicit path to .worklog directory (bypasses automatic directory resolution)
  -f, --file <filepath>   Output file path
  --prefix <prefix>       Override the default prefix
  -h, --help              display help for command contains the entire-database warning, (2) Usage: worklog import [options]

Import work items and comments from JSONL file. WARNING: This is a destructive operation that will REPLACE the entire database with only the items in the JSONL file. All existing items, comments, and dependency edges will be deleted. Use the --file option to specify the input path.

Options:
  -V, --version           output the version number
  --json                  Output in JSON format (machine-readable)
  --verbose               Show verbose output including debug messages
  -F, --format <format>   Human display format (choices: full|summary|concise|normal|raw|markdown|plain|text|auto)
  -w, --watch [seconds]   Rerun the command every N seconds (default: 5)
  --worklog-dir <path>    Explicit path to .worklog directory (bypasses automatic directory resolution)
  -f, --file <filepath>   Input file path
  --prefix <prefix>       Override the default prefix
  -h, --help              display help for command contains the destructive REPLACE warning, (3) test suite passes — 302 test files, 6314 tests passed. No changes needed.
